questions.q: When is the full manual Add Asset flow the most appropriate way to create an asset?
options: For every single asset addition, regardless of complexity
Only for assets below the capitalization threshold
When the asset is unusual or important enough to need field-by-field attention and overrides
Only when the asset originates from a Payables invoice
questions.explain: Manual addition is best suited to one-off, high-value, or non-standard assets where category defaults are likely to be overridden.

questions.q: Which information group includes the date placed in service?
options: Assignment information
Financial information
Location information
Category description only
questions.explain: Financial information includes cost, units, book assignment, and the date placed in service.

questions.q: Where do the depreciation method, life, and prorate convention values that pre-populate on a manual addition come from?
options: They must always be typed in manually with no defaults
From the category book for the asset's category and book
From the asset's location flexfield
From the General Ledger's accounting calendar
questions.explain: The category book (Chapter 2) hands over default depreciation method, life, and prorate convention, which can still be overridden on the form.

questions.q: What does an asset distribution represent?
options: A separate physical copy of the asset
A percentage allocation of an asset's depreciation expense to a specific cost center or account
The vendor who supplied the asset
A type of depreciation method
questions.explain: Distributions let a single asset's depreciation expense be split proportionally across multiple cost centers or expense accounts.

questions.q: In the inspection robot example, which category defaults were overridden?
options: Depreciation method and prorate convention
Useful life and salvage value
Location and asset key flexfield
Cost and date placed in service
questions.explain: The robot's life was overridden from the category's default 10 years to 7 years, and salvage value was set to zero, while method and convention stayed at category defaults.
